dolma_v1_6_mix.source: Dolma v1.6 composition, as reported by Ai2 (Soldaini et al., "Dolma: an Open Corpus of Three Trillion Tokens for Language Model Pretraining Research", arXiv:2402.00159; allenai/dolma dataset card).
dolma_v1_6_mix.total_tokens_v1: ~3 trillion tokens (Dolma v1.0), ~11 TB after curation from ~200 TB raw

olmo2_7b_config.source: OLMo 2 Team (Ai2), "2 OLMo 2 Furious", arXiv:2501.00656; allenai/OLMo-2-1124-7B config.json.
olmo2_7b_config.norm: RMSNorm, reordered to post-norm placement inside each sub-block (a change from OLMo 1's pre-norm)
olmo2_7b_config.notes: OLMo 2 also adds QK-norm (RMSNorm on queries/keys before the attention dot product) and a z-loss auxiliary term for training stability.

olmoe_config.source: Muennighoff et al. (Ai2), "OLMoE: Open Mixture-of-Experts Language Models", arXiv:2409.02060.
olmoe_config.routing: top-k token-choice routing, k=8 of 64, with a load-balancing auxiliary loss

tulu3_recipe.source: Lambert et al. (Ai2), "Tulu 3: Pushing Frontiers in Open Language Model Post-Training", arXiv:2411.15124; Ai2 Tulu 3.1 release notes.
stages: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on a curated persona-driven + skill-specific data mix
DPO on curated on-policy preference data (Tulu 3 completions vs. other model outputs, judged and ranked)
RLVR (Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards) on math, precise instruction-following, and other automatically-checkable tasks
tulu3_recipe.rl_algorithm_change: Tulu 3 (Nov 2024) used PPO for its RLVR stage with a learned value model; Tulu 3.1 switched RLVR to GRPO (no value/critic model, group-relative advantages), which the Ai2 team reported improved results and reduced compute per step.

chinchilla.source: Hoffmann et al. (DeepMind), "Training Compute-Optimal Large Language Models", arXiv:2203.15556.
chinchilla.compute_formula: C ≈ 6ND (N = non-embedding parameters, D = training tokens, C in FLOPs)
chinchilla.compute_optimal_ratio: ~20 tokens per parameter at compute-optimal allocation, agreed on (to within a small factor) by all three of the paper's independent fitting approaches at Gopher's compute budget (~5.76e23 FLOPs): 67B/1.5T, 67B/1.5T, and 40B/1.9T tokens respectively. The exact coefficients of the paper's parametric loss-curve fit (approach 3) are less robust than this ratio -- later reproduction attempts (e.g. Besiroglu et al., "Chinchilla Scaling: A replication attempt", arXiv:2404.10102) flagged ambiguity in the reported constants.
chinchilla.note: Production models (including OLMo, Llama 3, etc.) commonly train well past the compute-optimal point — i.e. more tokens per parameter than 20:1 — because the extra pretraining compute is repaid many times over in cheaper inference at a fixed, smaller parameter count.

stages.name: Pretraining
stages.note: ~5.9T tokens of natural data (web, PDFs, code, math, Wikipedia).

stages.name: Midtraining
stages.note: 100B curated tokens: synthetic math/code, QA, instruction, thinking traces.

stages.name: Long-context extension
stages.note: 8,192 -> 65,536 tokens; YaRN on full-attention layers only.

sliding_window.layers: 3 of every 4 layers use SWA; last layer always full attention

olmo3_longcontext.source: OLMo 3 report, arXiv:2512.13961v2 — Section 3.6 (long-context extension), Table 4 (Longmino Mix), Table 5 (RULER/HELMET).

ruler.note: RULER is the dev suite; HELMET is held out (some overlap with RULER, mostly easier subsets).

gzip_filter.note: Drop the most-compressible 20% and least-compressible 20% of documents.

longppl.note: Tested as a filter; did not outperform gzip, so not used for the final run.

synthetic_tasks.cwe: Common Word Extraction: ask for QA pairs whose answer is the exact count of a unigram in the partition.
synthetic_tasks.rex: Rewriting EXpressions: 12 vignettes (summary, dialogue, flashcards, quiz, game show, ...) requiring aggregation of a noun phrase.

olmo3_posttrain.source: OLMo 3 report, arXiv:2512.13961v2 — Section 4 (OLMo 3 Think), Section 5 (OLMo 3 Instruct), Table 8 (Think stages), Table 16 (Delta Learning), Figure 4 (DPO scaling), Table 6 (infra).

delta_learning.note: Continued SFT on the chosen model actually hurts; DPO on the (chosen, rejected) contrast improves every reasoning benchmark.

dpo_size_sweep.note: AlpacaEval and ZebraLogic improve up to ~75-100K preference pairs then decline; AIME 2024 is still improving at that budget. Dataset size is swept as a hyperparameter and early stopping matters.

length_bias.note: 80th percentile of chosen-minus-rejected token difference. Chat/multi-turn subsets filtered to a 100-token difference cap.

reasoning_first_instruct.note: Initializing OLMo 3 Instruct SFT from the Think SFT checkpoint adds ~3.3 points on the instruct benchmark subset.

multi_domain_rl.note: Dolci-Think-RL: ~100K prompts. Single-domain runs reach higher train reward but the mixed run generalizes better.

olmo3_rl.source: OLMo 3 report, arXiv:2512.13961v2 — Section 4.4 (OLMoRL), Table 6 (infra ablation), Section 6 (RL-Zero).
olmo3_rl.spurious_reward_control: Random signal-free binary rewards produce flat or degrading benchmark curves, evidence the RLVR eval sets were successfully decontaminated.

olmo3_eval.source: OLMo 3 report, arXiv:2512.13961v2 — Section 3.3 and Section 7 (evaluation suite), Table 17/18 (contamination), Section 4.1 (variance).

olmothreeeval.note: k=16 matches the GRPO group size and acts as an empirical upper bound on RL improvement; temp/top-p 0.6 chosen from a sweep over 5 models.

phases: detection: sample n-grams at a regular stride and match against benchmark n-grams
cluster expansion: expand matches on both sides and count adjacent contaminated n-grams against a threshold
decon_method.note: GSM8K was ~85% contaminated but not inflated; DROP generative showed +13.99 points of overestimation. High contamination does not always mean overestimation if a task is saturated or the contaminated format mismatches the eval format.

olmo3_midtraining.source: OLMo 3 report, arXiv:2512.13961v2 — Section 3.5 (midtraining), Table 3 (Dolmino Mix 2), Section 3.5.3 (findings).

microanneal.note: Target dataset tokens matched with web tokens; compare against a compute-matched web-only baseline anneal.

olmo3_midtraining.souping_32b: Merging two independent 32B midtraining runs (different seeds) improved MC_STEM by ~1 pt, GenQA by 0.4, Math by 2.9/1.6 vs the two runs, MMLU by ~1, and GSM Symbolic by 5/2.

olmo3_tools.source: OLMo 3 report, arXiv:2512.13961v2 — Section 5.2.1 (function-calling data), Table 9 (function-calling datasets), Table 10 (tools vs no tools).

format.call_encoding: pythonic code blocks wrapped in XML tags in the assistant role
format.note: Tool special tokens were added to the tokenizer for Instruct; unifying the format was crucial for stable tool use.
